_comment: Workshop stations declared element by element, over what data/talleres_3.6.10.10.json says of
their graphic (measured in the captures). For an element whose station is not its graphic's.
{ map, element, gfx, type, skills, why }

stations.why: The workbench by Kaponor's raft on the Tortuga beach [36,11] of the isle of Moon: «allez crafter en [36,11] à l'aide de l'établi : 6 x Planche en bois de kokoko, 2 x Poutre en bois de kokoko» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Le radeau ivre»). Skill 110, «Utilizar banco de trabajo», has those two recipes and no other; the captures saw the graphic (49504) as a handyman's workbench elsewhere (171).

Rubén Paket Hado's packing table in his tent at the Trool fair: «Primero, uno de los numerosos papeles de regalo que hay en mi tienda. Cuando lo tengas, usa uno de los talleres de empaquetado para envolver el objeto» (11401). The client's interactive type 145 is «Taller de empaquetado» and skill 209 «Envolver un regalo»; a paper and any one thing make the present the paper names (GiftWrapping).
The tent's second packing table (cell 359), the same as the first.

Natacha Manka's workshop at [-12,-60], the only quest element of her map (cell 246): «Ahora, utiliza mi material, vamos a tallar los troncos encantados juntos» (24836). The client's interactive type 298 and skill 349 are both «Taller de Natacha Manka», and 349 makes only the «Tronco encantado» (18203): ten bombu wood and a tamed corbac feather, five of them for «Pájaro de mal agüero».

The fresh eggs at [-15,-45] of the Litneg wood, the only quest element of the map (cell 183): «Cliquez sur les Oeufs frais (qui est en fait un atelier) pour fabriquer le Gâtrool Krosmique» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Jeu de Trooll»). The client's interactive type 299 and skill 350 are both «Huevos frescos», and 350 makes only the «Gatrool krósmico» (18208): a gatrool, twenty wild mint and ten cherries.

Bowis' workshop in [5,1]: «Examina el taller para descubrir las cantidades exactas» (Bowis, 16768; Dofus pour les noobs, «Qui botte les fesses des Bottes Fesses ?»: «Allez ensuite fabriquer les semelles de vent dans l'atelier spécial de Bowisse»). The client's skill 246, «Fabricar suelas», crafts the Suelas de viento (14980) and nothing else: 6 alas de escarahoja blanco, 8 semillas de la discordia, 10 plumas de kwak de viento, 2 piedras de esmeralda and 4 resinas. The element is the quest's own (484125, cell 315); the client names no interactive for the skill, so the type is the quest elements' -1.

Harmonie Daule's idol bench in her camp beside the Amakna church [6,3]: «Pour cela il faut se rendre en [6,3], là où une Huppermage spécialisée dans les idoles s'est installée. Il faudra crafter chaque idole nécessaire pour la quête. Pour cela il faut utiliser l'atelier spécial prévu à cet effet en [6,3] «Fabriquer une Idole»» (Dofus pour les noobs, «La bénédiction de Viti»); her own «Puedes fabricarlo usando mi mesa de trabajo» (55758). Skill 415 «Fabricar un ídolo» makes the thirteen idols, each one only while its quest asks for it (craftFeasibleCriterion «Qa=1660&PO!28444»). The element is the table of idols at cell 238, the only element of the map with no known type (gfx 49573). INFERRED type: 13, the plain workbench's.
